name: feature-spec-pipeline
description: Four native skills that run an issue-tracker-free, markdown-doc feature pipeline — /triage, /plan, /work, /gap-fix — entirely inside your interactive Claude Code session. /triage turns a feature idea (inline text or a notes file) into a versioned spec at docs/specs/spec-DIO-0001.md (id allocated from docs/feature-specs/LEDGER.md), running a codebase grounding pass plus a Specification Sentinel product/UX/compliance review and appending a non-technical readiness section. /plan classifies a tier, investigates the codebase, writes docs/plans/plan-DIO-0001.md and links it from the spec. /work implements the plan in an isolated worktree via dynamic ultracode workflows (understand → implement → rebase → acceptance review → resolve), appends a progress section to the spec, and leaves the branch local — no remote PR. /gap-fix runs after /work as the remediation step: it re-enters the work branch, ALWAYS re-audits the delivered code against the original spec (merging in any human/QA gaps you provide), and implements the fixes in code (file-disjoint fan-out + typecheck gates), looping audit→fix until only optional Low items remain, then commits locally and appends a gap-fix progress note — no remote PR. The plan, work, and gap-fix skills fan out parallel subagents via the Workflow tool (in small batches to avoid throttling). A doc-driven sibling of diolog-tasks-pipeline that needs no Diolog Tasks MCP. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance) with a new pipeline-wide canonical reference, skills/work/references/model-and-effort.md: the model × effort lane calibration (per-lane effort levels, `low` as the level built for subagents, effort-before-model because REVIEWER ≥ WRITER is about capability class not spend, `xhigh` + 64k `max_tokens` for long-horizon runners, hold-effort-constant for the prompt cache, never hardcode a dated model id in a wire self-check); the oracle-checks-vs-re-reading-your-own-work distinction that says which of the pipeline's heavy verification still earns its tokens; and a length budget for every written artifact. Applied across the skills: /work and tasks-worker's per-phase gate is now explicitly a conformance check rather than a second correctness review, adversarial finding-verification is aimed at Criticals/structural fixes rather than blanket 1:1, and no reviewer is ever briefed to 'be conservative' (followed literally, it lowers recall — report everything and filter after); triage and plan gain length budgets and the effort dial.
